method: Read-only primary-source refresh for materially stronger lawful, automatable, zero/near-zero-capital opportunities.

observed.reason: Automation is expressly permitted and payouts exist, but no measured unique-finding edge exists; competition, deposits on some work, human-validated PoCs, KYC and verified-wallet payout requirements prevent a stronger ranking.
Subscriptions/pay-per-use exist, but a 25% fee, required external API operations and absent paid-conversion evidence do not cure commodity-data demand uncertainty.
Recurring billing exists, but public downloads do not reveal paid conversion; review, legal, support and bank-payout obligations arrive before demand is proven.
The current homepage states that the platform is winding down and closing.

cantina_reopening_test: Offline replay of ten completed public scopes with reports withheld; require at least 25% precision, two unique accepted-equivalent medium/high findings and estimated return above USD 50/hour before reconsideration.
